articles.title: Are millionaires really leaving Massachusetts? We don’t know yet.
articles.description:
The IRS data analysts use to track high-income migration after the 2023 millionaires tax still isn’t available. That hasn’t stopped the debate over whether wealthy residents are leaving.

The post Are millionaires really leaving Massachusetts? We don’t know yet. appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: IRS data on high-income migration post-2023 millionaires tax is not yet available.
Debate continues over wealthy residents potentially leaving Massachusetts amid tax changes.
Uncertainty may affect local economies and funding for public services in Boston.
